scenarios.reason: Created marked disposable MAIN/mate homes and drove the real carrier, registered check, and steering inbox; MAIN returned that it has no walker dispatcher. fm-grok-bot-dispatch.sh is absent from PATH and the repository, and documented as operator-private under MAIN data/bin. Using operator-private configuration/services or relocating sign-in is forbidden. The available grok CLI is not this bridge; the targeted suite uses a simulated dispatcher and cannot establish live dispatch. Provide an authorized disposable MAIN instance containing the real dispatcher and access to its existing signed-in bridge, with an isolated walk target, then rerun.

notes: Both focused suites completed with exit 0. Initial runs with TMPDIR inside the hidden gate path were rejected by isolation guards; using their standard temporary fixture location resolved those setup failures.

The first manual walk check expected different wording for the correctly returned missing-dispatcher refusal. Its assertion was corrected and the walk-only rerun completed with exit 0. The original transcript is retained.
